none: PAS LON-8E2A64: A Roman silver denarius of an unknown Emperor dating to 1st-3rd century AD.

A Roman silver denarius of Carausius (AD286-293). Reece period 14 (AD275-296). The obverse depicts the bust of an Emperor, in profile facing right. The reverse depicts the Emperor on horseback riding right. The position of this motif on the coin suggests there is a captive beneath the horse.
